text:
Marta (Partnerships): Heads-up: AuroraEdge + VectorSys SI aiming for a marketplace listing next Friday. They asked about publishing HSM attestation artifacts and a KMS integration note. @Eli @Jon any constraints?
Eli (Security): Public: short SOC2 blurb and a redacted pen-test executive summary. HSM attestations can be referenced but not publish device serials or private certs. We can publish a verification statement that the firmware signing key is held in a FIPS-140 HSM and the attestation blob (base64) may be placed in the private bundle.
Jon (Marketplace): Marketplace wants a signed attestation PDF, a one-paragraph public bullet list, and presigned links for reviewers. We prefer 14-day presigns. Who will be responsible for uploads?
Vikram (HW SI): VectorSys can provide an HSM attestation statement, a KMS integration diagram (redacted), and a firmware-hash file. They asked whether a KMS endpoint hostname is publishable.
Eli (Security): Do not publish internal hostnames or IPs. KMS diagram can be high-level ("customer-managed KMS region: EU-West-1"). Remove any ARN or account IDs.
Marta (Partnerships): Pri, legal: any wording constraints for HSM/KMS claims? Aurora wants to say "keys stored in customer-managed HSM" on listing.
Pri (Legal): Keep claims factual and time-bounded. Example: "Signing key K was generated and maintained in a FIPS-140 HSM as of 2026-04-01." Avoid warranty language. Use our marketplace attestation template for signatures.
Jon (Marketplace): evidence-bot: confirm presign path and TTL so we can give VectorSys the upload instructions.
evidence-bot: preflight ok. Upload prefix: `s3://redwood-marketplace/evidence/auroraedge-vector-2026-04/`. Default presign TTL: 1209600 seconds (14 days). Presign example: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace/evidence/auroraedge-vector-2026-04/<file> --expires-in 1209600`.
Vikram (HW SI): We'll run a scrub pipeline: strip serials, ARNs, account IDs, and replace with placeholders. We'll produce: `public/firmware-sha256.txt`, `public/soc2-extract.pdf`, and private HSM attestation blob `private/hsm-attestation.b64`.
Eli (Security): Redaction checklist: remove device serials, account IDs, hostnames, IPs, private keys, and any PII. Add a redaction note at top of each redacted doc. HSM attestation blobs go to private only.
Marta (Partnerships): Proposed minimal public manifest:
- public/soc2-extract.pdf (1 page, redacted)
- public/pen-test-summary.pdf (redacted)
- public/firmware-sha256.txt (sha256 only)
- public/attestation-marketplace.pdf (signed by AuroraEdge)

Private bundle (presigned):
- private/full-soc2.pdf
- private/pen-test-full.pdf
- private/hsm-attestation.b64 (private)
- private/evidence-index.txt

Owners & deadlines: VectorSys upload to presign path Tue EOD (Vikram lead); Pri to review attestation language Wed AM; Eli redaction check Wed PM; Jon to generate presigns Thu AM; Partnerships approve listing Thu PM. Primary reviewer: Marta, backup Vikram.
Pri (Legal): I'll draft the attestation template and share a link.
Eli (Security): Quick note: if Aurora wants to allow verification of the HSM attestation, provide a verifier tool in the private bundle and instructions, never raw private certs.
Jon (Marketplace): I'll post presign links here once generated and attach reviewer checklist.
Marta (Partnerships): Thanks team. If all on schedule, target Friday announcement. Ping here for any slips. :thumbsup:
